design.title: Design System
design.identityText1: The Tower of Babel is often cited as a cautionary tale of hubris, yet I see it as the ultimate testament to human curiosity. We build not to challenge the divine, but to measure our own reach. It represents the audacity to construct languages, systems, and narratives that bridge the gap between the earth we walk on and the ideals we dream of.
design.identityText2: I choose to climb with the full knowledge that gravity waits for no one. To code, to capture, and to create is to risk a magnificent failure in pursuit of a singular breakthrough. I would rather scorch my wings against the sun than never leave the ground, for the view from the ascent is worth the fall.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What exactly does a session entail?
faq.a1: I focus on narrative architecture. This is not basic tutoring. We analyze your existing profile, identify structural gaps, refine your presentation, and build a strategy to ensure your work is recognized by your target institutions.
faq.q2: Can you supervise a research project from scratch?
faq.a2: No. I do not act as a primary investigator or provide foundational technical instruction. I work with students who have a baseline of work or a clear direction but need high-level guidance on execution and presentation.
faq.q3: Does this framework require an international or privileged educational background?
faq.a3: Not at all. I am entirely locally educated. The framework focuses on universal communication, structural clarity, and strategic positioning. These principles apply regardless of your starting environment.
faq.a4: I take on a strictly limited number of clients to maintain focus. I am fully committed to my current academic timeline in Taiwan and will remain consistently available for the students I choose to work with.
